question.text: Two waves are simultaneously passing through a string and their equations are : <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mi>sin</mi><mi>k</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>v</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mi>sin</mi><mi>k</mi><mfenced><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>v</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced><mo>.</mo></math> Given amplitudes <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>12</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mm</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mm</mi></math>,  <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>x</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> and wave number <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>28</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> The amplitude of resulting wave will be _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>mm</mi><mo>.</mo></math>
